boundaries: System font retained; no font asset substituted.
No production state fixtures, bitmap overlays, mock UI redraw or fake live data.
No Root start/stop/reload, core download/install, real controller/backend, notification service or network-match service action.
MockWebServer serves isolated loopback GET fixtures for adjacent panel reads; API drafts cancelled.
Native window rasters composed with actual WindowManager gravity/dim attributes; status/navigation chrome, OS shadows, keyboard and GPU blur are not simulated.
Passed interaction tests and captured pages are not pixel-exact acceptance or device/runtime validation.
